	desc = eir_hold_oenach_decision_desc

		eir_visible_stage1_trigger = yes
		eir_stage1_trigger = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		eir_stage2_trigger = yes
		eir_irish_buildings_trigger = { COUNT = 1 }
		any_vassal = { count >= 3 }
		NOT = { has_character_modifier = eir_oenach_afterglow_modifier }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 175
		prestige = 350
	}

	effect = {
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_oenach_afterglow_modifier years = 6 }
		eir_vassal_opinion_effect = { MODIFIER = eir_oenach_opinion OPINION = 12 }
		capital_county ?= { add_county_modifier = { modifier = eir_oenach_ground_modifier years = 12 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_modifier = eir_throne_turmoil_modifier }
			remove_character_modifier = eir_throne_turmoil_modifier
		}
		add_prestige = 300
		add_piety = 50
		set_global_variable = eir_done_oenach
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0051 days = 30 }
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0210 days = 10 }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}

		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_personal_religious.dds"
	}
	ai_check_interval = 0
	sort_order = 40
	desc = eir_honour_saints_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = eir_honour_saints_decision_tooltip
	confirm_text = eir_honour_saints_decision_confirm

	cooldown = { days = 7300 }

	is_shown = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		eir_visible_stage1_trigger = yes
		eir_stage1_trigger = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		eir_stage2_trigger = yes
		has_global_variable = eir_done_monastery
		piety >= 400
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 200
		piety = 300
	}

	effect = {
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0180 days = 5 }
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}

eir_crown_king_of_munster_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_found_kingdom.dds"
	}
	decision_group_type = major
	ai_check_interval = 0
	sort_order = 40
	desc = eir_crown_king_of_munster_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = eir_crown_king_of_munster_decision_tooltip
	confirm_text = eir_crown_king_of_munster_decision_confirm

	cooldown = { days = 36500 }

	is_shown = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		eir_visible_stage1_trigger = yes
		has_title = title:d_munster
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_unique_crown_king_of_munster }
	}

	is_valid = {
		eir_can_create_provincial_kingdom_trigger = { DUCHY = d_munster }
		prestige_level >= 3
		eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 15 }
		eir_irish_buildings_trigger = { COUNT = 2 }
		has_global_variable = eir_done_oenach
		has_global_variable = eir_done_cashel
		NOT = { exists = title:k_eir_munster.holder }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 750
		prestige = 1200
		piety = 300
	}

	effect = {
		eir_create_title_effect = { TITLE = k_eir_munster }
		set_global_variable = eir_unlock_ringfort
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_modifier = { modifier = eir_house_high_kings_modifier years = 30 } }
		add_prestige = 600
		eir_legend_title_effect = { TITLE = title:k_eir_munster }
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0110 days = 7 }
		set_global_variable = eir_unique_crown_king_of_munster
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}

eir_celtic_brotherhood_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_social.dds"
	}
	decision_group_type = major
	ai_check_interval = 0
	sort_order = 40
	desc = eir_celtic_brotherhood_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = eir_celtic_brotherhood_decision_tooltip
	confirm_text = eir_celtic_brotherhood_decision_confirm

	cooldown = { days = 36500 }

	is_shown = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		eir_visible_stage1_trigger = yes
		eir_stage2_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_unique_celtic_brotherhood }
	}

	is_valid = {
		eir_stage3_trigger = yes
		has_global_variable = eir_done_oath
		eir_ports_trigger = { N = 3 }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_done_brotherhood }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 400
		prestige = 1200
		piety = 300
	}

	effect = {
		every_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_gael_pride_opinion opinion = 30 }
		}
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_celtic_brotherhood_modifier years = 15 }
		add_prestige = 500
		set_global_variable = eir_done_brotherhood
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0218 days = 10 }
		set_global_variable = eir_unique_celtic_brotherhood
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}

		add_prestige = 250
	}

	}

eir_proclaim_gaeldom_decision = {
	picture = {
		reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_found_kingdom.dds"
	}
	decision_group_type = major
	ai_check_interval = 0
	sort_order = 40
	desc = eir_proclaim_gaeldom_decision_desc
	selection_tooltip = eir_proclaim_gaeldom_decision_tooltip
	confirm_text = eir_proclaim_gaeldom_decision_confirm

	cooldown = { days = 36500 }

	is_shown = {
		eir_is_irish_ruler_trigger = yes
		eir_visible_stage1_trigger = yes
		eir_stage3_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_unique_proclaim_gaeldom }
	}

	is_valid = {
		eir_stage4_trigger = yes
		has_global_variable = eir_done_brotherhood
		has_global_variable = eir_done_renaissance
		eir_realm_size_trigger = { N = 30 }
		eir_can_create_gaeldom_trigger = yes
		NOT = { exists = title:e_eir_gaeldom.holder }
	}

	is_valid_showing_failures_only = {
		is_available_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 1500
		prestige = 4000
		piety = 500
	}

	effect = {
		eir_create_title_effect = { TITLE = e_eir_gaeldom }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_gaeldom_emperor_modifier years = 30 }
		dynasty ?= { add_dynasty_modifier = { modifier = eir_house_high_kings_modifier years = 60 } }
		add_prestige = 2000
		add_piety = 300
		eir_legend_title_effect = { TITLE = title:e_eir_gaeldom }
		trigger_event = { id = eir.0112 days = 7 }
		set_global_variable = eir_unique_proclaim_gaeldom
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 0
	}
}
